desc: Derive and document the closed-form counting formula for exactly k equal adjacent pairs.
Implement modular combination C(n-1, k) using factorials and modular inverses, or an equivalent O(k) method.
Implement countGoodArrays using the closed-form formula and handle edge cases such as m=1, n=1, and k=n-1.
Verify the solution against the provided examples and a few small brute-force cases.
